name: SIM
author: LizardMan
description: A drum engine whose page is a physics simulation: every hit throws a solid into a virtual box, and what it does shows the key's sound. Its size is the pitch, its bounce the decay, its throw the sweep, its debris the noise, and a scope along the top draws the sound. It follows the endless sequencer's transposition and your colour theme. SIM draws with orbit3d, which goes in mods beside it.
